top_insertion.final_seating_proof: Land is the vertical hypograph of downward-facing frozen facets over fixed XY polygons; raising core increases separation at every XY. Reverse path seats without penetration.

axial_float.scope: Relative rigid fit envelope of each frozen port versus its fixture; not independent motion of a connected vascular branch. No production port is moved.
axial_float.land_policy: Analytic tangent land contact; excludes zero-gap lands from positive-distance search, separately checks straight-span engagement at approved float. Print-specific contact is uncalibrated.

trim.guide_method: Shallow inner-bottom / inner-wall mold relief transferred to PDMS; guides dissolve with mold, transferred marks remain until trim.
